parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, border/facility/custody ban, or state-directed targeting is documented; constitutional/statutory gender-identity non-discrimination and hate-motivation aggravation are positive climate signals and suggest discovery would not trigger legal persecution. But visitor-facing protection is not shown to operate: enforcement of the anti-discrimination/hate-crime framework is weak, an old ombudsman report shows impunity for anti-LGBT killings, and societal discrimination/exclusion is reported (broad, dated/current uncertainty). Moderate poll acceptance and military/trans-serving signals only weakly offset poor recourse. Resident LGR, marriage, adoption, blood-donation and free-union items were not credited. No documented subnational regime; thin evidence resolves below reduced risk due to unproven remedies, but above high risk because consequences appear mainly social/institutional discrimination without criminal targeting.
